With `n` records, `p95_ms` is the value at 1-based rank `ceil(0.95 * n)`. The rank is computed in integer arithmetic as `(95 * n + 99) // 100`, so there is no float error.\n\nExamples: n=20 gives rank 19, n=21 gives rank 20, n=100 gives rank 95.\n\n## Rules\n\n- The input list and records are not mutated; a sorted copy of the durations is used.\n- No file, network or other I/O.\n\n## CLI\n\n```\npython3 -m logreports input.jsonl --report latency\n```\n\nPrints the result as JSON with sorted keys.\n"
